data.name: Ooze Empathy
data.description: An oozemorph gains the shifter's wild empathy class feature, but she can use it only to influence the attitude of oozes with an Intelligence score of 2 or lower. An oozemorph can use this ability on mindless oozes; when she does so, she imparts a modicum of intellect to the ooze to allow it to respond to her commands. This alters wild empathy.
